item.title: Attention Walkthrough
item.description:
In this post we will walk through a very simple example of multiheaded attention is computed. The goal is to keep the dimensions small so that it’s easier to understand what’s going on. For a more conceptual explanation of attention, see A Few Notes on the Transformer.

Step 0: Define some constants

We will use the three tokens ['major', 'league', 'baseball'] with model dimension 4 (d_model=4) and two attention heads (num_heads=2).

item.title: A Few Notes on the Transformer
item.description:
For a more mechanical explanation of the self-attention and multi-headed attention calculation, see the Attention Walkthrough.

In this post I will describe the attention mechanism, commonly used in transformers, a popular neural language architecture. Most of the most well-known large language models of late are based on the transformer architecture. Attention was first described in Attention is All You Need by Vaswani et al.
